applies_when: One measured quantity across a few x-labeled treatments
An adopted mean and sample-SD definition with all raw units
caption: replicate-neutral-compact/caption.md
mechanism: Compact open summaries leave definite intervals and raw observations visible; x positions decode the single quantity.
avoid: Broad filled summaries dominate the sparse replicate layer; choosing a bar width is a geometry decision as well as a hue decision.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.2d PDF p4: neutral single-series bars
scWAT Fig.3j PDF p5: bounded open bars and raw marks
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 60 × 62 mm; declared data region: 43.80 × 47.12 mm from the fixed margins.
Four categorical summaries use bar width 0.36 category-spacing units, leaving room for intervals and raw marks.
